reason: A terminal-native interactive chat UI for DeepSeek Harness, with folded thinking and tool-call displays, terminal-aware theming, and TokenDance model routing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持工具调用展示、思维折叠和终端主题适配的交互式终端聊天界面。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness with tool-call display, collapsible reasoning traces, and terminal-aware theming.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness
Displays model responses, thinking traces, Markdown, and tool-call output in a terminal UI
Routes model requests through a configured TokenDance OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Supports interruption of an active agent turn and presentation of harness tool activity
